sources.title: AITOT — The Online Totalizer for AI Costs
sources.snippet: AITOT is the online totalizer for AI infrastructure costs — free 2026 calculators for token pricing, GPU rentals, vector databases, inference benchmarks, and ROI. Compare 20+ models in real time.

sources.title: First-Time Setup | tota
sources.snippet: If model discovery fails, tota asks you to re-enter the key instead of accepting random text. If you enable Telegram during first-time setup, tota starts a temporary pairing flow: send /start to your bot in Telegram, copy the pairing code you receive there, then paste that code into the CLI to finish setup.

sources.title: tota Documentation | tota
sources.snippet: tota is a self-hosted assistant that runs locally, connects to your preferred channels, and uses a rich toolset for coding, research, and automation. You stay in control of data, permissions, and where it runs.
